added_lines: the events comprise recitation of the rosary, a reminder of the mission of laity through gospel and the catechism, as well as information on the work of human life international ireland, sponsoring seminarians to priesthood in tanzania (13 ordinations taking place this summer), helping women in crisis pregnancy situations (630 babies lives saved so far), holy face devotion, and promoting the authentic teachings of the catholic faith, working for an ireland where god is first, life is sacred and the family is cherished. feedback for the nights has been excellent and some clergy have attended the events including bishop cullinan in waterford and lismore.

the “vocations monstrance” is part of the church’s ongoing commitment to promote and foster vocations to the priesthood and to religious life. the monstrance will be in various churches in the diocese to encourage prayer for vocations and to deepen young people’s awareness of god’s call in their lives. through prayer before the blessed sacrament, we ask the lord to raise up generous and joyful servants for his church. vocations are born in prayer, sustained by prayer, and strengthened through prayer. any parish wishing to have the “vocations monstrance” during these 2 weeks, please contact fr rory brady at

tip to knock: dear parishioner, the cursillo movement invites you to join them for a sponsored trip to knock on sunday 19th july, (to coincide with arrival of the national cursillo mass). the bus leaves from sun lounge, 10 am on the 19th of june at 7:30 am. bring a packed lunch and there will be a list available in the sacristy for you to book a place as places are limited. for further details book a place please contact pat saturday or john 937 4001 by friday 10th july at the latest.

when we have listened to your ideas we will be in a much better position to make the right decisions regarding adoration in the parish of raphoe. every hour in itself is a commitment and so all the adorers have to make good commitment. it seems nowadays people do not like making such commitments. so please pray about this and let fr kelly or anyone on the parish of raphoe committee know your thoughts on adoration in our parish.

are delighted, in fact thrilled, to announce that fr eamon kelly is getting rid of the beard in a sponsored beard and head shave. it will take place at the diamond, donegal town on saturday 11 july from noon to 4pm. mary’s meals are presently feeding 3,060,011 children every day in school and €22 provides food for a child for a full school year. any support is greatly appreciated.

this sunday after the liturgical feast of saints peter and paul - the traditional peter's pence collection takes place. this is a concrete way to support the holy father in his mission of service to the universal church. donating to peter’s pence is a concrete gesture of communion with the holy father and of solidarity with his mission to bring the gospel throughout the world.
